description.en: Six-yao (I Ching) divination for DeepSeek Harness: xiantian bagua backdrop, Zhouyi opening verse, manual entry with three-coin hints or simulated coin toss, najia charting (six relatives, six gods, void branches, hidden spirits, nayin, seasonal strength, advancing/retreating transformations), interpretation whose every statement cites its classical source, a plain-language recap, and a one-hexagram-one-question follow-up dialog. Zero npm dependencies, no network access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的六爻算卦插件：先天八卦盘背景、周易开场辞、带三枚铜钱提示的手工输入或电脑摇卦、六亲/六神/旬空/伏神/纳音/旺衰/进退的纳甲排盘、逐条注明典籍出处的解读、通俗总结，以及「一卦一断」追问对话框。零 npm 依赖、无网络访问。
